source.scores: uint16/65535 represents P score/(P score+E score), not calibrated biological probability. Published model sigmoid; working3 model softmax.

tiling.aggregation: Each core pixel retained once; black exterior padding. No resizing.

source.evaluation: Proof of concept; no claim of independent performance.

measurement_method: Horizontal main-root skeleton path, quarter-resolution topology, smooth native-coordinate polyline and core tissue scores. Length = sum Euclidean distances along trace. Not exact original PAT implementation.
transition_rule_description: Close enclosed gaps <=150px and retain basal-connected Periderm.
anatomical_assumption: Basal/hypocotyl end is on the right; requires review.
